bugs.detail: Native non-PC1/2/3/4 clears score100/300/600/1000 instead of100/300/500/800; actual empty-board PCs give the same points instead of900/1500/2300/2800. The second single adds175 rather than150 (level2:350 rather than300). Separated Tetrises give1000 then1000 rather than800 then1200. No spin history or recognition: native ridge T real rotation into zero-travel mini/full gives0 instead of100/400, including timed locks and actual browser keys. Native travelling control gives24 for12 rows; exact10x20 HD-SPIN-1 fixtures are inexpressible on9x18. These related scoring defects form one group.

bugs.detail: The round(850*0.82**(level-1)) curve gives850/697/384/142ms first-row boundaries at levels1/2/5/10 rather than1000/793/356/65. Level2 starts at8 cleared lines rather than10. Wrong low/middle curve and line cadence form one progression group; no extra floor deduction.

bugs.title: Lock delay, reset allowance and lower-row clock handling differ

Leaving without the440ms wait still retains10 resets at the lower floor;400ms,Right,100ms welds4 cells instead of granting a fresh delay. No airborne lock; contact timing is correctly split.
